shortBio.en: Pink Floyd keyboardist; pads, electric piano, and harmony vocals across the classic albums.
shortBio.zh: Pink Floyd 键盘手；经典专辑中的 pad、电钢琴与和声。

body.en:
Born 1943, London. Founding keyboardist. Electric piano, organ, and synth pads define much of the mid-1970s texture.

Dies 2008.
body.zh:
1943 年生于伦敦。创始键盘手。电钢琴、风琴与合成器 pad 构成 1970 年代中期大量织体。

2008 年去世。
